entities.name: Fluoro-methyl anisole
observations: Standardized substrate: COc1ccc(C)c(F)c1, an aryl methyl ether bearing methyl and fluoro substituents.

entities.name: Fluorocresol
observations: Standardized product: Cc1ccc(O)cc1F, the corresponding phenol after aryl O-demethylation.

entities.name: Aryl O-demethylation
observations: The transformation cleaves the aryl O–CH3 bond while retaining the aromatic C–F bond and ring framework.

entities.name: BBr3 in dichloromethane
observations: Directly matched empirical record uses boron tribromide with dichloromethane for conversion of the aryl methyl ether to the phenol.

entities.name: Boron tribromide
observations: High-confidence reagent for cleavage of the aryl methyl ether in this transformation.

entities.name: Dichloromethane
observations: Solvent used in the directly matched empirical record with BBr3.
